risks.risk: Memory card error could indicate a faulty card slot/contacts or a deeper electronics fault rather than just a bad card
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on with a known-good memory card inserted, showing it reaches the shooting screen without error
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working (storage function unverified)

risks.risk: Dark patch on lower-left body in photo 2 could be corrosion from liquid exposure, which often causes hidden internal damage
risks.proof: A close-up, well-lit photo of that specific area and the battery compartment interior
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural damage present, lowering condition grade

risks.risk: Zoom lens mechanism and autofocus function not demonstrated in motion
risks.proof: A short video of the lens extending/retracting and autofocus engaging on a subject
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens/zoom function unverified, treated as potentially faulty

risks.risk: Battery and charger not shown; without them the camera cannot be used immediately
risks.proof: A photo of the included battery and charger alongside the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as accessories missing, buyer must source separately

risks.risk: Actual image/photo quality (sensor, lens clarity) cannot be judged from product photos alone
risks.proof: A sample photo or video taken BY the camera, uploaded unedited
risks.if_unproven: priced as image quality unverified, assume lower-tier output

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on with a working memory card, reaching normal shooting screen (no error)
Close-up photos of the dark/worn patch on the lower-left body and the battery compartment
Video of lens zooming in/out and autofocus attempting to focus
Photo of battery and charger included in the sale
One unedited sample photo taken with the camera to confirm image output
response.reason: Camera is clearly identifiable as a Canon Digital IXUS 95 IS compact with visible flash and 10MP label, but the visible 'Memory card error' and worn/possibly corroded casing contradict the seller's 'good condition' claim, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof of normal function.
